description: Designs and writes the complete multi-page website of a real-estate office or property developer (home with a 3D hero, listings with search, services, about, contact with WhatsApp) from its name, city and services, in any language, and returns a link where the owner sees it now. No account: the draft stays 7 days; the owner keeps it by opening a free trial on Dar. Takes about a minute.

about.description: What the business offers, in the owner’s words (services, areas, what sets it apart)

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the business (e.g. SA, AE, EG, NG, US)

from.description: Optional: the business’s current page (its website, or its profile on a property portal or Google Maps) to write the new site from

kind.description: office = real-estate office / brokerage; builder = property developer

lang.description: The website’s language, an ISO code such as ar, en, fr, es, pt, tr, hi, id, zh-Hans (default ar)

phone.description: The business’s WhatsApp number with country code (optional)

name: real_estate_website_builder
title: AI website builder for a real-estate office or developer
